name: Feedback Studio
author: Bastiaan Kortenbout
description: Your running Feedback Studio review sessions in the Omarchy bar: open-comment counts, what the coding agent is doing, rich notifications, a QR code to review from your phone (Tailscale or tunnel), screenshot comments, and one-click starts for a folder, a Markdown file, the focused window's project, or the demo.

barWidget.description: Review sessions, open comments, agent activity, and a phone QR code for Feedback Studio.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget asks each running session for its comment counts while the panel is closed. The open panel refreshes every 2 seconds.

schema.label: Notify on new comments
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a session receives a new comment, for example from your phone.

schema.label: Clicking a comment notification
schema.description: What a click on a new-comment toast does: open the review page in the browser, or open Claude Code in the project and ask it to process the feedback (focuses the existing Claude Code window if one is already open there).

schema.label: Notify when the agent finishes a round
schema.description: When a coding agent leaves a session after resolving comments, show "Round done" with what it applied. Click it to open the page and play the walk-through.

schema.label: Unanswered question after (minutes)
schema.description: A question pin that no agent has answered for this long turns the badge urgent and sends one notification whose click starts Claude Code in watch mode. 0 turns this off.

schema.label: Phone access for new sessions
schema.description: Off: sessions started here stay on this computer. Tailscale: reachable from a phone on your tailnet, private, with a real certificate on Feedback Studio 1.4+ (older servers get --https --host 0.0.0.0 and a one-time certificate warning). Tunnel: a public HTTPS URL through a Cloudflare quick tunnel; works on any network, traffic leaves your machine.

schema.label: Server command
schema.description: Command that runs Feedback Studio. Empty means `npx -y feedback-studio@1`. Point it at a clone to run a development version, e.g. `node ~/src/feedback-studio/plugins/feedback-studio/bin/feedback-studio.mjs`.

schema.label: Picker starts in
schema.description: Folder the "Open a folder or .md" picker opens in. Empty means your home folder.
